arguments.new:
def get(self, key, default=None):
        p = self._path(key)
        if not os.path.exists(p):
            return default
        with open(p) as f:
            rec = json.load(f)

        # Treat an entry as missing once its age reaches the configured TTL.
        # Remove it as part of the lookup so expired entries do not accumulate
        # on disk indefinitely.
        if self._now() - rec["t"] >= self.ttl:
            try:
                os.remove(p)
            except FileNotFoundError:
                # Another reader may have removed it in the meantime.
                pass
            return default
        return rec["v"]
